confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Madrid price levels; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and bar anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because July rates vary by neighborhood, booking window and demand. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor where direct knowledge was weaker. The FX figure came from search-result summaries that later searches could not reproduce, so verify the 2026-10-14 RBA observation before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Madrid price levels, cross-checked informally against other large Spanish and southern European capitals with similar tourist demand, such as Barcelona and Lisbon.
